query: I need a game in a browser. The classroom Wi-Fi may be switched off after setup, and the arrow keys would be nice. I can spend $60 once and can't have an API bill every month.
The game must never run without an internet connection. Keyboard controls would be a bonus.
I want a game my daughter can play in airplane mode after installation. Touch controls would be a bonus.
I need a game that lets me close the tab mid-session and pick up exactly where I left off tomorrow.
Two people on separate computers must be able to play together at the same time.
I need a game that runs on my laptop's own server. Access over the public internet is optional.
I don't need multiplayer. A game I can play in Chrome is mandatory.
This must integrate with our existing Godot project. Local play is optional.
I need a browser game. It must not depend on Node.js.
The software must fit a $25 per month operating budget. The upfront license has no cap.
A browser game for strictly less than $0.01.
I need a browser game with a budget of 50.
I need a game I can play without internet, but installation may use the network.
A browser game. It needs to be cheap enough to run.
The game must work offline. It also must never work offline.
I need a browser game. Ideally I wouldn't be locked into a paid API, but that's negotiable.
